detect_interval.label: Detection interval
detect_interval.description: How often to check Steam's process log for a running game, in seconds.

current_refresh.label: Live player refresh
current_refresh.description: How often to refresh the current player count, in seconds.

stats_refresh.label: Charts refresh
stats_refresh.description: How often to refresh the 24-hour peak, all-time peak and graph from SteamCharts, in seconds.

background.label: Panel background
background.description: Draw the host panel behind this card.

background_color.label: Panel colour
background_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for the host panel.

background_opacity.label: Panel opacity
background_opacity.description: Opacity of the host panel behind this card.

background_radius.label: Panel radius
background_radius.description: Corner radius of the host panel, in pixels.

background_padding.label: Panel padding
background_padding.description: Padding between the host panel edge and the card, in pixels.

show_card_settings.label: Card layout controls
show_card_settings.description: Show the title, width, spacing, fill and border settings.

show_styling.label: Colour controls
show_styling.description: Show the accent, text and graph colour settings.

show_scaling.label: Graph and text scaling
show_scaling.description: Show the graph height, line width, fill opacity and text scale settings.

show_sections.label: Section visibility
show_sections.description: Show the cover, stat and graph visibility toggles.

title.label: Idle title
title.description: Title shown when no Steam game is running.

content_width.label: Card width
content_width.description: Width of the desktop card, in pixels. Use 320 to match Modern SysMonitor Plus.

card_gap.label: Card gap
card_gap.description: Gap outside the card, in pixels.

card_padding.label: Card padding
card_padding.description: Padding inside the card, in pixels. Use 10 to match Modern SysMonitor Plus.

card_radius.label: Card radius
card_radius.description: Corner radius of the inner card, in pixels.

card_fill_color.label: Card fill
card_fill_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for the inner card.

card_fill_opacity.label: Card fill opacity
card_fill_opacity.description: Opacity of the inner card fill.

card_border_color.label: Card border
card_border_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for the inner card border.

card_border_width.label: Card border width
card_border_width.description: Width of the inner card border, in pixels.

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
hide_when_idle.description: Render an empty zero-size card when no Steam game is running.

show_title.label: Show idle title
show_title.description: Show the idle-card title (SteamDB Stats). The game name is always shown while a game is running.

show_settings_button.label: Show settings button
show_settings_button.description: Show the settings cog in the card header and idle card.

show_cover.label: Show game cover
show_cover.description: Show the game's store header beside the title.

show_peak_24h.label: Show 24-hour peak
show_peak_24h.description: Show the highest concurrent player count in the last 24 hours.

show_peak_all_time.label: Show all-time peak
show_peak_all_time.description: Show the game's all-time concurrent player peak and its age.

show_attribution.label: Show data source
show_attribution.description: Show the SteamCharts and Steam attribution line.

accent_color.label: Accent colour
accent_color.description: Palette role or hex colour used for the live count and cover placeholder.

text_color.label: Text colour
text_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for primary text.

muted_text_color.label: Muted text colour
muted_text_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for labels and attribution.

graph_color.label: Graph colour
graph_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for the 24-hour graph line and fill.

graph_height.label: Graph height
graph_height.description: Height of the 24-hour graph, in pixels. The network chart default is 32.

graph_line_width.label: Graph line width
graph_line_width.description: Width of the graph line. Modern SysMonitor Plus uses 1.5.

graph_fill_opacity.label: Graph fill opacity
graph_fill_opacity.description: Opacity of the area below the graph line. Modern SysMonitor Plus uses 0.15.

text_scale.label: Text scale
text_scale.description: Scales every text size independently of the graph dimensions.
